info.name: GymPro 4.0 API
info.description:
Full API collection for GymPro microservices platform, routed through the API Gateway (port 8080). 9 services: Eureka, Gateway, Auth, Member, Trainer, Plan, Booking, Notification, Payment, Chatbot.

Auth: most endpoints require a JWT Bearer token obtained from Auth > Login (auto-saved to {{token}} via the collection-level test script). Role-restricted endpoints additionally require an X-User-Role header (ADMIN / TRAINER / MEMBER).

request.description: Creates a new user. role=ADMIN triggers the admin-approval flow instead (see Verify Admin Registration).
If no admin exists yet, the very first ADMIN registration is created immediately. Otherwise a verification code is emailed to existing admins.
Step 2 for ADMIN signups when other admins already exist.
Returns a JWT in `token`. A test script saves it to {{token}} automatically.
Step 1 of password reset — emails a 6-digit OTP.
Used service-to-service; not normally called from the frontend.
Typically called right after Auth > Register with role=MEMBER.
Trainers who self-registered and are awaiting approval.
Only allowed if the slot has not been booked.
